scope: Read-only renderer audit over every preserved 1858-1859 period_review source; no RAFT export or accepted evidence changes.
method: Compared the renderer's retained raw block baseline to period_review paragraphs, then recorded issue-only rendering audit data. Source prose is not copied into this sidecar.

guarantees: ID-scoped rendering is refused by callers when baseline alignment fails.
Code-point scopes receive an explicit hold after MathML, table, list, superscript, or visual transformations.
Images are never silently treated as text; affected output receives a visual_dependency hold.
Headers, salutations, footnotes, supplemental material, bibliography, annotations, and navigation are excluded according to retained extraction semantics.

limitations: This audit verifies extraction alignment and deterministic issue detection; it does not establish historical eligibility, accepted relationships, visual interpretation, or export readiness.
Transformation and hold detail is recorded only for affected sources; unchanged source prose remains in preserved HTML.

markup_inventory.interpretation: Class inventory is a review signal only. del/add/supplied/editorial and line-break nodes are not silently normalized; source-specific decisions remain holds or require authoritative evidence. Bracketed text is retained unless its source class or accepted extraction excludes it.
